tools.description: Resolve any Indian Supreme Court reference — INSC neutral citation, SCC, AIR, MANU, party name + year, or free text — to the canonical INSC neutral citation with parallel citations, bench, decision date, official e-SCR link, and current treatment status. tools.name: get_ratio
tools.description: Return the extractive, paragraph-anchored ratio decidendi and headnotes of a Supreme Court case — the exact judicial language counsel can read in court. Never paraphrased; every holding carries a paragraph anchor and an official-text pointer.

tools.name: search_cases
tools.description: Search the insc.one Supreme Court index by natural-language issue, keyword, or legal proposition. Returns ranked cases with INSC citations, one-line holdings, and treatment signals.

tools.name: check_treatment
tools.description: Check whether a cited Supreme Court authority is still good law — overruled, distinguished, or affected by a larger bench under the Article 141 bench-strength hierarchy. Run this before including any authority in a draft or filing.

tools.name: format_citation
tools.description: Return a ready-to-paste citation string that leads with the INSC neutral citation, with optional parallel SCC/AIR/SCR/MANU forms and a registry-style footnote. Use this to standardize citations in drafts and pleadings.
